**Want to know what's really in your food? The Trump administration is trying to help** By Bobby Jindal and Taylor Hood
---
Americans have a right to know what is in their food.

That shouldn’t be controversial. You should be able to walk into a grocery store, read a label, and be confident that the ingredients listed on the food you are buying have been subject to transparent, science-based oversight and are safe for consumption. The Trump administration has now taken an important step toward doing exactly that.

The Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) proposed a rule requiring food manufacturers to notify the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) whenever they determine that an added substance is Generally Recognized as Safe, or "GRAS." When Congress passed the Food Additives Amendment in 1958, the idea was simple: ingredients with a documented history of safe use or those that qualified experts had agreed were safe should not face the same pre-market approval process as brand-new food additives. Everyday substances like salt, vinegar, black pepper, and baking powder fall into this category. Unfortunately, our regulatory system has fallen short of that basic standard. And over time, the exception became the rule.

Under the current system, manufacturers can self-determine whether a new additive is GRAS and introduce it to the U.S. food supply without notifying the FDA or the public. The manufacturer is still responsible for maintaining evidence to support its own determination, but the FDA may have no advance notice when a new substance enters the supply chain.

The Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) proposed a rule requiring food manufacturers to notify the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) whenever they determine that an added substance is Generally Recognized as Safe, or "GRAS." When Congress passed the Food Additives Amendment in 1958, the idea was simple: ingredients with a documented history of safe use or those that qualified experts had agreed were safe should not face the same pre-market approval process as brand-new food additives. Everyday substances like salt, vinegar, black pepper, and baking powder fall into this category. Unfortunately, our regulatory system has fallen short of that basic standard. And over time, the exception became the rule. Under the current system, manufacturers can self-determine whether a new additive is GRAS and introduce it to the U.S. food supply without notifying the FDA or the public. The manufacturer is still responsible for maintaining evidence to support its own determination, but the FDA may have no advance notice when a new substance enters the supply chain. | | Email sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com by AmericaNext

body:
This is Pennsylvania, Derek — the swingiest of swing states. Donald Trump won here in 2024, outside groups are prepared to pour millions into our Commonwealth, and the far-right is looking for any opening they can find to pull off a victory.

The Democratic Socialists Party wants to take over South Carolina.

clean_body: Results from my role as your representative in Congress. | | | | August has been a busy month in Northwest Washington. I have spent time meeting with local leaders, visiting community organizations, listening to your concerns, and working to bring federal dollars home to the communities I represent. This month, I helped bring home more than $7 million in federal funding for Washington State Ferries' Anacortes - San Juan Islands and Port Townsend - Coupeville routes. Rural communities I represent need more support and funding from the federal government. These dollars will help Washington State Ferries serve my constituents whose lives and livelihoods are tied to ferries. As the top Democrat on the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, I will keep fighting for federal investments that make Washington's ferry system more reliable and create good-paying jobs. I also announced $1.3 million in federal funding for Everett Ship Repair and Rozema's Boat Works in Mount Vernon. The maritime economy and the jobs that come with it are alive and well in the Puget Sound. Funding like this supports local small businesses, helps regional economies grow, improves shipyard facilities and equipment, and supports workforce training. I visited Optum's Stanwood Clinic and Safe Harbor Free Clinic to tour the facilities and hear from local health care providers about the challenges facing their patients and the impact of Medicaid cuts. Access to affordable health care should be a right to families across Northwest Washington. Hearing from the people providing care in our communities helps guide my work in Congress as I fight to reduce health care costs and expand access to high-quality health care that fits families' budgets. This month also brought good news for service members who want to start families. After nearly a decade of advocacy, starting next month, service members will be eligible for the first federally funded program to help cover the cost of freezing eggs or sperm before hazardous missions. No one should be forced to choose between serving their country and starting their family. **[But first, I need to ask: Will you chip in any amount you can before tonight's end of month fundraising deadline to help me make history as South Carolina’s first Black governor?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138246021/643575008/858395174?refcode=083126_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAwNzkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDI5YjdmMmUtNWNhNS1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=hRKQHQ-SQGNdUWKM7KOESrX83dXB0ADHCfaspB7C4wA=)** Early in my campaign, I was attending a Zoom chat with a group of supporters when someone wrote these words:

“Trump is going to remove you n****** soon its only a matter of freaking time. YOU STUPID BLACK N*****”

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138246022/643575009/858395174?refcode=083126_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAwNzkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDI5YjdmMmUtNWNhNS1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=hRKQHQ-SQGNdUWKM7KOESrX83dXB0ADHCfaspB7C4wA=)

subject: MassGOP Chair - Vote September 1st: Writing in Anne Brensley for Secretary of State
body:

| MassGOP Chair - Vote September 1st
---
---
| My Fellow Republicans, As we approach the September 1 primary, I write to urge every Republican in Massachusetts to vote and remain actively engaged in our party's work.
Primaries are not optional exercises. They are the critical first step in choosing the strongest candidates who will carry our values into the general election. When Republicans stay home, we leave the selection of our nominees to a smaller, less representative group. When we show up, we ensure our candidates reflect the full strength and diversity of our party.
Your participation also sends a clear message: Massachusetts Republicans are ready to fight for better government.
Voting in the primary, volunteering, donating, and talking with neighbors are the practical steps that grow our ranks and strengthen our infrastructure for the long term.
---
| |
---
| We also have the opportunity to write in Anne Brensley for Secretary of State, ensuring another critical statewide office is challenged on the November ballot.
Accountability is not optional in a healthy democracy--it is the foundation. When one party controls every statewide office for decades, the result is complacency, reduced transparency, and a government that answers more to itself than to the people.
By writing in Anne Brensley, Massachusetts voters can send a clear message: no position is beyond scrutiny, and every statewide office should face real competition. That is how accountability is restored and how better government is built.
Every Republican vote in the primary matters. It shapes the quality of our nominees, expands our base, and positions us to hold one-party rule accountable. I ask you to make the time to vote on September 1, encourage your fellow Republicans to do the same, and stay involved in the weeks and months ahead. Together, we can build a stronger, more competitive Republican Party in Massachusetts.
Sincerely,
---
| |
---
| Amy Carnevale Chairman, Massachusetts Republican Party

Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met.

| | | I need to tell you something I don't talk about enough.

Outside of my office, a group of extremists gathered and screamed what translates to**"Death to Krishnamoorthi"** at the top of their lungs.

A crowd of people, in America, calling for my death.

I'm an immigrant. The son of people who came to this country with nothing because they believed it was a place where you could live freely, speak freely, and serve your community without fearing for your life. A place where disagreement didn't end in threats of violence.

Sadly, this is nothing new. I have faced this before.

A sitting Republican elected official also publicly tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media to report me as a **"foreign occupier"** with an **"unpronounceable name"** and called for the mass deportation of Indians. I have been mocked, threatened, and told in a hundred different ways that someone like me doesn't belong in American public life.

And every single time, I have made the same choice.

Keep going.

Because the moment I stop — the moment I let the hatred win — is the moment I break faith with every family that came to this country believing it was worth fighting for. Including my own.

This is the America we are living in right now. Extremists feel emboldened to threaten, intimidate, and silence the people who are trying to do the work. Hatred has been given permission to operate in the open. The machinery of government is being used to make certain communities feel like they don't belong.

**Equal Opportunity Now exists because we need leaders who have faced this kind of hatred and didn't flinch**. Who know what it costs to keep going and choose to keep going anyway. Who will stand up — not just for themselves, but for every family that is being targeted, threatened, and told they don't belong.

Those leaders are out there. And they need our support right now.

name: Crystal and Jason via ActionNetwork.org
subject: Vs. Goliath Is Over. Now We Take Action.
body:
Help us raise $20,000 to train and equip community pipeline and water monitors. | | | Dear 7DS Community,
FROM _VS. GOLIATH_ TO ACTION Last week, we wrapped up our in-person _Vs. Goliath_ film screenings in Chapel Hill, bringing together community members, organizers, and frontline leaders to share stories about what happens when communities are forced to stand up to powerful corporations and infrastructure projects. The screenings reminded us that telling these stories matters, but our work cannot end when the lights come back on.
## MORE EYES ON THE GROUND. MORE PROTECTION FOR OUR WATER.
Pipeline construction is moving through communities, forests, streams, wetlands, and watersheds across North Carolina and Virginia, and government inspectors cannot be everywhere. Our next step is putting more trained community members on the ground. 7 Directions of Service is raising $20,000 to expand our Community Pipeline Watch by recruiting, training, equipping, and deploying additional construction and water monitors. Our monitors help document construction conditions, erosion and sediment concerns, impacts to streams and wetlands, changes in water conditions, and other potential environmental concerns associated with the Southeast Supply Enhancement Project (SSEP), MVP-related infrastructure, and the Enbridge pipeline project affecting Chatham County, North Carolina. This work helps create a community record of what is happening on the ground and ensures concerns can be photographed, mapped, documented, and reported to the appropriate agencies.
## [HELP US REACH $20,000](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fyDnf0MZkZOQ033LB4o6yMvt7Xkzemo-urgTI61Lz5aG8zjyJcdSi8XI_gxUCUvGTFECfH9_s3fj0GZFoUk_jrmhySrMJVnxDZ8MrDApx_9Bd8b78dJSfkkZOIFVF38FfqqCIWSqway50wjVmcwF7iz8usNgqWHBFSolwCiLp905f0x5sVUXe_NvCt_5qGwujSKkMGNLQZyUYBqUV8lj9EhMbR6kMlj_PrBfYPudP6qJka0IxnPxa6YTIch2RPr3RTUPgTMDqShMNTU85fP228zSZHkuoI4AhoZt03gL1-OVCY0y5OeHT4ZK4JYJ9VfA/4tn/lEKDqPRaSRexLPjtruGe8A/h0/h001.k5ILl1aYkkfUNUeLuuAY_SK5_QR77-H7s0GFWuKt5bA)
**$250 — Equip a Monitor:** PPE, field supplies, and documentation tools. **$500 — Water Watch Sponsor:** Water-monitoring equipment and field supplies. **$1,000 — Community Monitor Sponsor:** Train, equip, and deploy a community monitor. **$2,500 — Monitoring Team Sponsor:** Support equipment, mileage, training, and multiple field deployments. **$5,000 — Pipeline Watch Partner:** Make a major investment in expanding monitoring across impacted communities. _Vs. Goliath_ helped us tell the stories of communities standing up to powerful interests. Now we are putting that message into action. More monitors mean more eyes on construction, stronger documentation, and greater protection for the water and communities we call home. Every purchase helps 7 Directions of Service expand our network of community construction and water monitors working to protect our land, waterways, and communities from pipeline impacts. clean_body: Help us raise $20,000 to train and equip community pipeline and water monitors. | | | Dear 7DS Community, FROM VS. GOLIATH TO ACTION Last week, we wrapped up our in-person Vs. Goliath film screenings in Chapel Hill, bringing together community members, organizers, and frontline leaders to share stories about what happens when communities are forced to stand up to powerful corporations and infrastructure projects. The screenings reminded us that telling these stories matters, but our work cannot end when the lights come back on. MORE EYES ON THE GROUND. MORE PROTECTION FOR OUR WATER. Pipeline construction is moving through communities, forests, streams, wetlands, and watersheds across North Carolina and Virginia, and government inspectors cannot be everywhere. Our next step is putting more trained community members on the ground. 7 Directions of Service is raising $20,000 to expand our Community Pipeline Watch by recruiting, training, equipping, and deploying additional construction and water monitors. Our monitors help document construction conditions, erosion and sediment concerns, impacts to streams and wetlands, changes in water conditions, and other potential environmental concerns associated with the Southeast Supply Enhancement Project (SSEP), MVP-related infrastructure, and the Enbridge pipeline project affecting Chatham County, North Carolina. This work helps create a community record of what is happening on the ground and ensures concerns can be photographed, mapped, documented, and reported to the appropriate agencies. $250 — Equip a Monitor: PPE, field supplies, and documentation tools. $500 — Water Watch Sponsor: Water-monitoring equipment and field supplies. $1,000 — Community Monitor Sponsor: Train, equip, and deploy a community monitor. $2,500 — Monitoring Team Sponsor: Support equipment, mileage, training, and multiple field deployments. $5,000 — Pipeline Watch Partner: Make a major investment in expanding monitoring across impacted communities. Vs. Goliath helped us tell the stories of communities standing up to powerful interests. Now we are putting that message into action. More monitors mean more eyes on construction, stronger documentation, and greater protection for the water and communities we call home. Help us raise $20,000 and put more community eyes on the ground. Wear the Watch. Support the Work. Our new Community Pipeline Watch T-shirt is here! # **RPVI Endorses Eric Tillett for Senate**
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Yr4Ka4ixykq?e=4f81ceec6f&c2id=39a671a1d75d16cde42206c3cb925b2d)
| |
Dear Friends,
Last week, we promised to introduce our candidates and share the plans they are bringing to voters across the Virgin Islands.
**Today, the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands is proud to endorse Eric Tillett for Senate in the St. Thomas–St. John District.**
Born and raised on St. Thomas, Eric has spent much of his adult life building businesses, managing property, and dealing with problems government has struggled to address. He approaches public service as an entrepreneur: understand the problem, know the numbers, develop a plan, and make sure the work gets done.
Eric has developed detailed proposals on infrastructure, development, and government services. One example is his plan to address sewage and wastewater across the islands. Eric recognizes that failing systems threaten our reefs, our ecosystem, tourism, future development, and quality of life. His plans also consider how major private developments can help pay for the infrastructure their projects require.
That is the kind of practical thinking our Legislature needs.
For nearly three decades, the Legislature has operated without a single Republican member. Electing Eric would bring another voice to the Senate—one willing to ask hard questions, challenge business as usual, and demand results from our government.
We invite you to read our new profile of Eric and learn more about the experience, ideas, and practical approach he would bring to the Legislature.
---
| [READ ERIC’S FULL PROFILE ](https://us.list-manage.com/YJiuEWtzMpj?e=4f81ceec6f&c2id=39a671a1d75d16cde42206c3cb925b2d)
---

More competition means more accountability, which creates a better government for all of us.
Onward!John Yob

| Of all the reasons I decided to run for Congress, sending fundraising emails was nowhere near the top of the list.
But building a campaign and a movement accountable to working people means asking a lot of people to give what they can, and trusting that together, it will be enough.
And right now, we really need the support.
I don't know if you've heard, but the House just introduced a resolution to condemn socialism "in all its forms" and the platform of the Democratic Socialists of America.
I would love to dismiss this as another silly Republican stunt meant to rile up their base and distract from the rising prices under Donald Trump.
But I would not be surprised if members of our own party joined them.
They can see where the Democratic Party is moving and that there's a growing number of working people who are demanding leaders who answer to us instead of billionaires - and it scares them.
[So with our August end-of-month deadline being tonight at midnight, I'm asking that if you're in a position to give, will you contribute $15 or more to help us reach it and send a proud democratic socialist member to Congress?](https://irrem7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001TtLcVY8cG_gSqMSm2y4Qb8rQqpx_yQRrN_OkZ95AwyqbwQ6o6xpu9JKltVavOygEbHv1a6DEdCbm8IepJbNX3fgywk_cpmgsvasM8035JmjCDBik8QC-0PQrqfDHq7IDxkog30yJnXA8rv3lLbhPLR_PkyA8NIEvBSRJQwWCfd6ZzQr1x_xOLyAlLkljSTKPeqq28q7VdSJPEw4KDs_hjmVmw3wbinwvx8StZBDAgDc=&c=wzJBSylMOuvLbhxrcUdy5gT7VhlyQjpSD-B4j_tdJ_ovjQC7OgRSUA==&ch=SZIidKwDQTTw3bJ8Yf-H3axu3gkN5MvHJ9UHkvackyq4GSnWWIOMng==)
I may never get comfortable asking, but I will always be grateful that you answered!
Solidarity forever,
Claire

Growing up in Endicott, New York, I saw what happens when corporations call the shots. They put profit over people, and working families are left behind. My dad, my grandparents, and generations before them worked in local factories until they closed, but Wall Street continued to enjoy soaring corporate profits.
Now in Congress, I fight back against corporations that try to get away with record-breaking profits by raising utility costs for people.
In the past few months, that has meant standing up to corporations trying to build AI data centers in our community _and_ demanding answers from utility companies. I'm a fifth-generation Upstate New Yorker and a dad. About RNC Chairman Joe Gruters:Joe is a fourth generation Sarasotan and descendent of Ringling Circus chief tentmaker William Hobson, his great grandfather who moved the family to Sarasota in 1922. A 1996 graduate of Cardinal Mooney High School, Joe is also a graduate of both Florida State University, where he earned his undergraduate degree, and the University of South Florida, where he earned his MBA. Joe is a partner at Robinson Gruters and Roberts, a CPA firm with offices in Sarasota County. For the last 25 years, Joe has been working at the grassroots level as both a Republican Party activist and leader. He served as Chairman of the Republican Party of Sarasota for 14 years, Chairman of the Republican Party of Florida for 4 years where he was undefeated in state wide elections and served as member of the Republican National Committee for 4 years where he served as Chairman of the Election Integrity committee. Joe has also served as a member of the Electoral College representing Florida during the 2016 and 2020 elections and was the co chairman of the 2016 Republican National Committees platform committee on Restoring the American Dream. Joe currently serves as a State Senator representing Sarasota and Manatee Counties. He serves as the Florida Senate Regulated Industries Chairman. Joe is an active member of the Sarasota County community and local government. He has served as Chairman of the Sarasota County Planning Commission, on the Board of Directors for the Florida Sports Foundation, as Treasurer for the Sarasota Humane Society and as a Governor Rick Scott Appointee to the Board of Trustees for Florida State University, where he was Chairman of the Finance and Audit Committee and Presidential Compensation Committee. Joe currently serves on the University of South Florida Community Leadership Counsel at the Sarasota Campus. Joe is married to Sydney and they have three children – Spencer, Jack and Elizabeth.

Friend,
I know we’ve been reaching out a lot, but by 11:59 p.m. tonight, we really need to hit our $500,000 end-of-month goal. Right now, we’re falling short, but if another 1,000 grassroots donors contribute before midnight, we can close the gap. **[Can I count on you to chip in $10 now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138250796/643588245/-540544497?amounts=10,25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk436&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjYxMjYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmVjNDRlNGEtNjJhNS1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Vif1EnK-9l1YbwaA_eNr5is2wJOj7RCbZ-GGu7-eXhI=)**
Missing this goal is simply not an option, friend. Let me explain:
On the day I became the official nominee, a super PAC formed and launched a wave of attack ads to deceive voters about who I am and what I stand for. They’re spending big on this — more than $1 million so far. Missing our goal tonight means we can’t keep our own positive ads on the air. It means that we let Sen. Oil **[futures jumped](https://substack.com/redirect/e8f7f514-3e57-4bed-94a1-5013b5ccc0ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Monday after the first U.S.-Iran **[exchange of fire](https://substack.com/redirect/7f9ebde1-a0e1-4f73-81fe-af516a280074?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in a month, with Brent reclaiming $90 as QatarEnergy **[extended LNG cancellations into November and diesel cracks neared $100.](https://substack.com/redirect/206cb735-1959-471d-a766-6859b3d636d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
* **Brent reclaims $91 handle:** November Brent rose 3.4% to $91.08 and WTI gained 3.4% to about $86.21 after the first U.S.-Iran firefight in weeks.
* **Diesel sits at epicenter:** Goldman energy strategist Daan Struyven warned diesel remains "at the epicenter of the supply squeeze" as U.S. diesel cracks again neared $100 a barrel.
* **Qatar extends force majeure:** QatarEnergy told Italy's Edison another 5 LNG cargoes slated from late September to early November will not arrive, lifting canceled Edison cargoes to 29.
* **War cuts Qatari loadings:** Qatar shipped only 18 LNG cargoes in the war's first 6 months versus 509 a year earlier, a drop estimated to have cost about $24 billion.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent opened **[G20 finance talks in Asheville, N.C.](https://substack.com/redirect/4e01e78e-7b33-48e4-9754-b9bafc263f71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , saying the world is "awash in debt" and predicting Iran's economy could buckle in weeks or months under U.S. pressure.

* **EU backs economic outcast:** Bessent thanked the European Union for "fulsome support" of Operation Economic Outcast, the secondary-sanctions drive against **[Iran's financial enablers.](https://substack.com/redirect/5e7d5178-434d-436d-8045-134e2218fcd9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* **China surplus on agenda:** Bessent said the world **[cannot accept China's $1.2 trillion trade surplus](https://substack.com/redirect/01315e87-1529-4110-b10e-508c87b6819f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and floated a 7.5% tariff step ahead of a Trump-Xi meeting.

# [Warsh went hawkish. September hike odds just slammed to 60%](https://substack.com/redirect/0dab8718-2212-410b-acd3-0c4a9c46385c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Markets **[raised the chance](https://substack.com/redirect/6903c71e-11eb-43f6-b7ce-826f2c941735?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of a September Fed hike to 59.9% after Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech, while **[long European yields](https://substack.com/redirect/670a25ec-e3c8-4510-9555-56ff0e25edbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** jumped as **[oil and fiscal](https://substack.com/redirect/4eb792ba-70fd-4ef4-baeb-ad3f32a44fb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** risks returned.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0dab8718-2212-410b-acd3-0c4a9c46385c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Barclays now expects hikes:** Barclays economists called for 25-basis-point increases in September and December after Warsh flagged "concerning" inflation trends over the past year.
* **Odds doubled since speech:** CME FedWatch put the chance of a September hike at 59.9%, up from 35.4% the day before Warsh spoke at Jackson Hole.
* **French yields near 2008:** **[France's 10-year yield](https://substack.com/redirect/32e0c13f-38aa-4a5e-a929-1f89fcf37953?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** hovered near 4.13%, a post-2008 area, with debt above 115% of GDP and the IMF seeing about 118.5% in 2026.
* **German bund hits 15-year:** Germany's **[10-year bund yield reached a 15-year high](https://substack.com/redirect/c4e52f1f-5aed-44a9-8b0a-892c51a10959?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/c4e52f1f-5aed-44a9-8b0a-892c51a10959?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)as long U.S. yields edged up and French OATs traded cheaper than Italian BTPs.

# [China's factories are stuck in contraction as a record fleet just ringed Taiwan](https://substack.com/redirect/0dab8718-2212-410b-acd3-0c4a9c46385c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
China's official factory PMI rose to 49.8 in August from 49.2 in July **[but stayed below 50,](https://substack.com/redirect/4d5dfcc0-c9e1-4278-bff9-0c9b07e6d35f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as Taipei reported a record 244 Chinese government ships **[operating around Taiwan.](https://substack.com/redirect/529e5602-c303-4090-9453-e56d553cf4d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0dab8718-2212-410b-acd3-0c4a9c46385c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Factories shrink second month:** August's official manufacturing PMI of 49.8 beat the 49.6 forecast and July's 49.2 print but remained in contraction for a second month.
* **Orders edge back above 50:** Production and new-order sub-indexes rose to 50.4 and 50.6, while new export orders rebounded to 50.1 from 49.6.
* **Record 244 government ships:** Taipei Times counted 244 Chinese coast guard, research, and other government vessels around Taiwan, up from 55 in June, excluding PLA Navy warships.
* **Blockade risk stacks higher:** About 45% to 50% of Taiwan's crude imports normally transit Hormuz, layering energy-war risk onto a 2027 blockade tail for markets.

# [Trump just went after the beef packers that ranchers blame for $7 beef](https://substack.com/redirect/0dab8718-2212-410b-acd3-0c4a9c46385c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Trump said he is authorizing legal documents to give ranchers **[the right to process their own food,](https://substack.com/redirect/edd8f47a-5de7-4555-b4c3-c076e4718c66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** targeting 4 meatpackers that control roughly 85% of U.S. processing capacity.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0dab8718-2212-410b-acd3-0c4a9c46385c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Four firms hold 85%:** Cargill, Tyson Foods, JBS USA and National Beef Packing Co. control roughly 85% of the country's meat-processing capacity, a grip Trump called a "nasty monopoly."
* **Import quota drew backlash:** The announcement followed pushback from cattle producers on a plan to allow tariff-free imports of up to 300,000 metric tons of foreign beef.
* **Rollins tees up Monday:** Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins said actions starting Monday would cut red tape, support smaller processors, and expand ranchers' ability to sell meat across state lines.
* **Herd sits at 75-year low:** The U.S. cattle herd sits at its smallest level in roughly 75 years, adding pressure in a market ranchers blame on dominant packers.

# [John Ternus takes over Apple tomorrow. AI is the test he can't fail](https://substack.com/redirect/0dab8718-2212-410b-acd3-0c4a9c46385c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
John Ternus **[becomes Apple CEO on Sept. 1](https://substack.com/redirect/64cdff80-59b5-432a-8b6b-59ba04fecf0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as Tim Cook shifts to executive chairman, inheriting an immediate fall product cycle and pressure to close Apple's gap in artificial intelligence.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0dab8718-2212-410b-acd3-0c4a9c46385c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Cook keeps Trump and China:** Tim Cook, CEO for 15 years, told staff he will keep handling Apple's relationships with President Trump and the Chinese government as executive chairman.
* **Sept. 9 is first test:** Apple's Sept. 9 Cupertino event is expected to feature the first foldable iPhone, new Apple Watches, and a rebuilt Siri powered by large language models.
* **Siri rebuild uses Gemini:** Apple decided to rebuild Siri using Google's Gemini as its foundation after delays and an AI-leadership shake-up; full deployment is set for September.
* **Hardware chief, new gaps:** Ternus, 51, joined Apple in 2001 and ran hardware engineering; the company still faces a memory-chip shortage it does not expect to resolve before next year.

The Blue Dogs are helping me do that, and that's why I'm reaching out. Here are two reasons why we can flip this seat that wasn't on the map just a few months ago: 1️⃣ Max Miller has shown voters exactly who he is over the last couple of weeks. This is a guy who got his career handed to him, spent his time in Washington taking care of his donors, and has now shown the people of this district and, frankly, the whole country that his moral bankruptcy runs deeper than his voting record. 2️⃣ New GOP polling shows us leading Miller. That's right, we're ahead by double digits — 14 points — in a district Trump won by double digits just two years ago. = = If you have saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your contribution to Brian Poindexter and Blue Dog PAC will go through immediately: | = | | = ---|---|--- = | | = = | | = In solidarity, Brian | If you would like to receive fewer emails, we understand. to sign up for only the most important updates, or you can . name: Nick Begich
subject: What a Month
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alaskans for Nick Begich
body:
This is only the beginning, Alaska | | | | [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/4AXlOIQgQe2?e=6679001ba0&c2id=4b8979688b40abb82eda840804c92b8e)
---
| | | Friend,

**What a month.**

Yesterday, we walked into the first AOGA debate and made the case for Alaska. For the jobs, the energy, and the future that this state has been waiting decades to build. And we won it. Not because of clever lines, but because we had a record to stand on and a vision to point toward.

That win came on the heels of our primary victory, and I want to be clear about something: none of it happened because of me. It happened because of you. Every door you knocked, every call you made, every sign you planted in your yard, every conversation you had with a neighbor. That's what carried us through August. Thank you. I mean that.

**But I'll be honest with you. The job is only beginning.**

We are just over two months out from the November 3rd election. Alaska is finally unlocked. After years of being told "no" by Washington, we are moving toward a self determined future, one where Alaskans decide what happens on Alaska's land and with Alaska's resources. One good term deserves another, and we are not about to hand that progress back.

Because here's what's happening on the other side: the radical socialists and their hand picked candidate, Bill Hill, are pouring millions into Alaska right now. They think they can buy this seat. They think Alaskans can be told what to think.

We know better. But knowing isn't enough. **We have to outwork them.**

Here's what I'm asking of you between now and November 3rd:

• Knock on doors in your neighborhood
• Make phone calls to voters
• Put up a sign, or ten
• Host an event, big or small, in your home or your community
• Write an op ed or a letter to the editor
• Share our message on social media
• Talk to your friends and neighbors about what Team Begich has delivered for Alaska

**Sign up to volunteer here:[www.AlaskansforNickBegich.com/volunteer](https://us.list-manage.com/KkXkiDEZ6o4?e=6679001ba0&c2id=4b8979688b40abb82eda840804c92b8e)**

Every one of these things matters. Every one of them is something the other side's money can't buy.

Now is the time to double down in the fight for Alaska. **I'm all in. I hope you'll be too.**

For Alaska,
Nick Begich

P.S. If you can only do one thing this week, have one conversation with someone who hasn't made up their mind yet. That's how we win, one Alaskan at a time.

[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/127772?t=8&akid=28382%2E878179%2EYxenpj)
_This is TERRIFYING news right before the midterms._**We can’t let them get away with this!**

[We’re calling on every local Democrat to sign our letter DEMANDING the Postal Service protect vote-by-mail. Add your name before your spot expires at MIDNIGHT »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/127772?t=9&akid=28382%2E878179%2EYxenpj)

TO: U.S. Postal Service
FROM: Willis
Subject: Please don’t cave to Trump.

Dear USPS,

**I am writing today to DEMAND that you stand up to Donald Trump and PROTECT vote-by-mail.**

Vote-by-mail has expanded voting access to millions of Americans in rural areas, serving overseas, and in marginalized communities.

Limiting access to states who do Trump’s bidding is UNDEMOCRATIC and straight up AUTHORITARIAN!

The Postal Service is a vital institution that has done so much good for our country — **so please don’t sacrifice everything you stand for now.**

[I’m signing this letter today to DEMAND you stand up to Trump and this disgusting attack on voting rights. Along with my signature, I’m chipping in $3 to the Voter Protection Project to ensure we flip the House this November and SAVE vote-by-mail »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/127772?t=11&akid=28382%2E878179%2EYxenpj) | [SIGN THE LETTER ASAP: DEMAND USPS PROTECT MAIL-IN VOTING »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/127772?t=12&akid=28382%2E878179%2EYxenpj)

David Shuster asked Hunter Biden a question I ask carefully, because a lot of people in recovery have told me the same thing: that it never really leaves you. That there is always a compulsion underneath, always a pull, and the work is managing it. Is it a daily struggle for you too?
He did not give the answer I expected.
_" I am no longer an addict. I'm not an addict anymore. I am in recovery, but I will always be vulnerable to anything that is a mind-altering substance."_
Then he laid out what that means in practice. He can never again let himself take anything that lifts his mood, or changes how he behaves, or quiets his anxiety, unless a doctor knows about it. Not once. Not ever. He said it without drama, the way you would describe managing any other disease.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.Ut3MbgzBCY1BTXkamkGZjbZOcRjxVwieAbaNFtGqYzY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=213551041)
I have talked with a lot of people about this. I have never heard anyone put it that precisely. He is not claiming to be cured. He is refusing to be defined forever by the worst chapter of his life while also refusing to pretend he ever gets to relax. That is a hard place to stand. He stands there in public, while a president and an entire propaganda operation use "crack addict" as a punchline about him roughly once a week.
That clip is free. Watch it. Send it to somebody who needs to hear it.
The whole conversation is not free, and today is the day I have to tell you about that.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8c1dbdac-a42a-4d71-81d3-7d99744e3500?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We went well over an hour, and he did not dodge a single question.
He walked me through the money. His paintings brought in about $200,000 a year, and every single person who bought one was hauled before Congress to testify under oath about the purchase. Set that against $3.9 billion in defense contracts steered to Don Jr.'s private equity outfit, formed weeks before his father took the oath of office. "But meanwhile," he said, "what about my paintings?"
He said Bibi Netanyahu is a ghoul, and then built an argument about Pharaoh and the Jewish people that I have not stopped thinking about since. He told me what he actually thinks about Kamala Harris distancing herself from his father, which he could have skated past and did not. He talked about going on with Tucker Carlson, a man who was once his friend, and about the tanning session Tucker offered him. I am not going to explain that one here.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5eb87f30-0113-4a76-9207-6bc504966d5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

| We can’t let Tuberville destroy Social Security
---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2961%2E259176%2E6zjS52) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2961%2E259176%2E6zjS52)_

Folks,

With all the problems facing our state and our country, you’d think that Tommy Tuberville would use his Senate seat to do something to help the people of Alabama. But what did he choose to do?

**He went on the Senate floor and called Social Security a scam.** [](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14589?t=10&source={%&akid=2961%2E259176%2E6zjS52 include_tmpl
custom_fields.mailing_source_code %}&amount=22) To borrow the word Tuberville used when Alabamians raised legitimate concerns about data centers—if you’ll pardon my language for a moment—**bullcrap.**

Social Security is not a scam. **It is a promise we make to working people that after a lifetime of hard work, they can retire with some dignity and security.** Hundreds of thousands of Alabamians depend on Social Security, but Tuberville wants to privatize Social Security and place folks’ retirements in a risky stock market, rather than Treasury bonds, so his rich friends can make money.

Here’s the part that gets me. Tommy Tuberville has collected more than **_$93,000_** in Social Security benefits over the past three years, on top of his Senate salary and all the money he has made trading stocks while serving in office.

He has no problem cashing his own Social Security checks. **He only has a problem when hardworking Alabamians expect to receive theirs.**

That tells us a whole lot about the kind of governor Tuberville would be. He will take every benefit the government offers him, use public office to enrich himself, and then pull the ladder up behind him. One set of rules for Tommy Tuberville and his wealthy friends, and another for everybody else.

I believe a governor ought to stand up for people who work hard, play by the rules, and count on their government to keep its word. Tommy Tuberville has shown us again and again that he would rather look out for himself.

**We can keep Tuberville’s self-dealing politics out of Montgomery.** I’m running the most competitive campaign for governor Alabama has seen in 20 years, but I need your help to win.

And we can win. Democratic turnout doubled in this year’s primary, while Republican turnout fell by 25 percent even after nearly $30 million was spent. Republicans, Democrats, and independents are showing up at our town halls because they are ready for a government that works for them again. But Tuberville still has a huge financial advantage, and I need your help to overcome it. Peter,

The ink was barely dry on last night's primary results when the attacks started.

Cook Political Report downgraded our Senate race from "Likely Republican" to "Lean Republican." That is not a clerical change. **[That is the left wing media signaling to every left-wing donor in America that they believe that Texas is in play.](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/-36C6U1HCUJC2GcCFEdA1mdqDytCTnjFCcXF-ndImp6cae32tFyLzvDGEtJYSHAW5POvVU1SKwQAXP3jFuEwY7La2ltbxh-C_gxrXKG90Fgh8or3kNYiZv6tIaV4f4cFbfDMy2Wy-u0vryGNZ1agQEUorgBMfvSGXmm2-f7W6Ci_GGWM67Hj7twXUm_SxhoKt04M5E64Wk_n180RIx85J9zDXoxAbPuAKZacsbqXaXDZsseTLYMtTcG4ntEWGzuPgxayKbftBGRuBUAipAqMQylkJGZIA91cB1f8yVK-srwjE-5dJe9Mp3BpEbFiUf7ulFknjK_9dMpx8DvB-G_h4MBccO9vbF1Oj0sizOkr5CUTURfjzSC0f8Y7OzRex65UwmOEIiT3_at0ztXlldDF8XUwY79Wzm3aTghH3CrhGp-_DEs2kxg_d7BcbddOVirqRGQvcbkIrsxluJqC_2B6wMaHym--sPBeBhNX-q45bPOAbN17vJG9vGuTR7M0bn72LUaVvAAdPmlfTiEIi4kmlxqVgFxogl1W8lZ2d2wFfCI1WcaGVi3JMNXfg-TiX_MnFAPZCGv1R1RXE1ytWtjT2AaAjaYsEzmiF2P9TsIkzZD4Ph4DjLz5_9oO-Z41aA7QTSpPqE91-ssyzoQ3kDi6ZnSjU4OIQ7MwOzhC0YgK2yq947TpsdEEZMoj0gNpXOrIArbTw115F0Zl1Yo7XdfayAjUf9y8xplVzVogrQg5CSi6fUdOVYLFF0X59HzIXDeT3nEzqslXRWYKskrOJaopQq2-j6nqdsvcSY-RG7wA9ITS-6861ggrJI9EiohMXbg89JBTLlKq6OBs3uigD1L0aIOF3nF43Zi1R_QqsSbVAChtKrR1TM6TmznjDzbExA7KOWgaf38JAyCpxjcUEsX1xmsgqiIdFF2ZH2mlgYYQtnyI5uf-rpB55qcOVSuf_FijmfYD2pLAg1JLg-9oZ8TiFBszYPVNo4HxgAWHPRXwnGUTwLBdI6cI50o_hVWjVkFQRt_VEEWBbk67ciVb_XFctbF-DYsSjZGPSD9blw8rZZr3nlHXF9TYbIC-nu-f1is/OJU6u16egcDAPoepPIlBqp6Iw8ZGTR-M/24)**

clean_body: 9 years for this?Convicted because of a cooler | | | | | | Dear Fellow American,This officer was just convicted of manslaughter for trying to stop a fleeing criminal with non-lethal force. Sgt. Erik Duran dedicated 15 years of his life to the NYPD.He earned dozens of commendations. He helped take illegal guns off the streets. He put his life on the line to protect his community. Now he's fighting for his own freedom – All because of a split-second decision he made during a drug bust in the Bronx. | | | | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled.Duran had only moments to react.He didn't reach for his firearm.He didn't use deadly force. Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him. The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries.Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison.And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. Duran and helping fund his appeal.But legal battles like this are long, difficult, and incredibly expensive.And while Erik fights for his freedom, his wife and children are left carrying the burden alongside him. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: You can’t just sit there with a “D” next to your name and call it a day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=3010%2E4032634%2EmewqUi)
---
All throughout this primary season, we’ve kept hearing from pundits and talking heads trying to figure out just what exactly the Democratic Party is all about — suggesting that we need to water down our economic agenda and not be “too progressive” or “too radical” in order to win. **But here’s the reality: The bold, progressive candidates who campaign on a real affordability agenda are winning.** While they continue to put together the puzzle on what the Democratic Party is, voters are not buying any BS. We’re electing leaders who understand what it really means to fight for working families. Who will take a stand when it’s hard and speak truth to power. Who refuse corporate PAC checks — even when it would be easier to take them. Who unapologetically propose bold economic reforms — not just small measures that nibble around the edges. **This is exactly why I launched Fight PAC: An organization to support, uplift, and help elect these types of fighters for the working class to Congress.** [**If you’re feeling energized by our movement’s recent wins, and you want to keep seeing actual fighters get elected to Congress, then please split a contribution between Fight PAC and our campaign before our midnight deadline tonight.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3782?t=8&akid=3010%2E4032634%2EmewqUi) My top priority is for Democrats to take back the House and the Senate in November. That is an absolute must. But at the same time, Democrats need our majorities to be filled with fighters who want to pass plans that truly transform the lives of working people in this country, not just sit there with a “D” next to their name. Contributions to Fight PAC will support candidates who know what it means to put up a fight. [**No more corporate PAC influence. No more watered-down compromises. No more rolling over and playing dead. We need leaders who are unafraid to get into the ring and put up a fight. If you agree, then please pitch in a donation to support Fight PAC and our campaign.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3782?t=9&akid=3010%2E4032634%2EmewqUi) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

Peter, I know how busy the end of summer is with back to school activities, so I’ll make this short.

A lot of good people right now are doing a very hard thing — running for office. These folks are stepping up to serve their communities and neighbors. They’re running to make life a little more affordable, and a little better, for all of us.

**But there’s no doubt about it — it’s hard. These candidates could use our help, which is why I’m reaching out today.**

Derek, the DNC told me I could reach out to you directly — so I’ll get right to it.
We’re currently tied against our opponent, Mike Rogers:
**_Michigan U.S. Senate Poll**_
🟥Mike Rogers 45%
🟦Abdul El-Sayed 45%
⬛ Don’t Know 10%
That's not a comfortable place to be with only a few weeks left. But it does tell you something important: _this seat is winnable_.
That explains why MAGA Republicans are throwing everything they have at us. **The GOP's Senate Leadership Fund Super PAC has already committed over $51 million to try and flip this seat red.**
They know exactly what's at stake — there is no path to a Democratic Senate majority without Michigan:
* Winning here could be the **tipping point** that flips the Senate majority blue.
* If we lose, Donald Trump and his MAGA base can continue to shove through disastrous legislation with **little to no checks on his power.**

I was a sideline reporter for pro football and basketball. I covered some of the most exciting games in history. I watched sports for a living. And I loved every minute, every touchdown, and every Hail Mary.
I reached the pinnacle of my career... but there was one problem:

clean_body: This is Michele Tafoya – I’ve got a quick story to share if you’ll indulge me for a few moments. | Hi there, I hope you are well! Folks might've killed to have my job. I was a sideline reporter for pro football and basketball. I covered some of the most exciting games in history. I watched sports for a living. And I loved every minute, every touchdown, and every Hail Mary. I reached the pinnacle of my career... but there was one problem: I had to watch what I said. I was a public-facing representative for a world-class sports network. I couldn't share everything I believed, and no one really knew I was a Conservative. So I hung up my press badge and quit my dream job so I could speak my mind. It was the hardest decision I've ever made. I was scared, excited, and liberated - all at the same time. People said I was OUT OF MY MIND. But I knew God was leading me in a certain direction, and that 's no time for half-measures. I knew he had a plan for my life. So I took a leap of faith and never looked back. I believe God put me here for a reason. I believe Minnesota is the land of 10,000 problems right now. And I believe a no-BS, sane person who 's ALL-IN can win this seat. But I 'd be lying if I said fundraising doesn't make a difference in a race like this. The far-Left is readying a FORTUNE to drown out our message and take this seat out of play. Our path to victory solely depends on raising enough to keep up. My finance team tells me we 'll need to bring in donors ASAP so we can: 1) Hire staff, 2) Recruit volunteers in every corner of the state, 3) Print yard signs, 4) Launch our advertising blitz, and 5) Start contacting on-the-fence voters. I 'm afraid that'll make the difference between a winning campaign and a losing one. | I put my career on hold to speak out for what I know to be true. Hey Peter,
---
Living in the country, you encounter a lot of situations that really make you think.For the second summer in a row, I’ve had animals messing up our AC, and I’ve had to figure out how to deal with it. Last summer, a possum got up under the house and destroyed a lot of ductwork. This summer, a mouse or some other critter got into the HVAC unit and obliterated the blower assembly (I’ll spare you the details). We have a great repairman who’s actually taught me quite a bit about HVAC repair. He even sent me up under the house last year to work on the ducting. But both this year and last year, getting things fixed has taken a while, so I’ve been living without central air a little longer than we’d like. We basically live in a swamp, and with 100-degree temps you have to have a little cool air to get by. But one of my life mottos is: “country boys will survive” ... which means I’m going to find a way to solve the problem and make things better. With the AC, this meant digging out some old window units in the barn and getting them going. But I’ll also be a problem solver as your elected representative. In Congress, I’ll work alongside colleagues to fix the issues hitting Americans hardest, like making everyday life more affordable, reforming health care, and addressing corruption in government. Problem-solving may be among the most important skills leaders should have, but I also think leaders need to listen and learn from others. When I get elected, I can guarantee you that I will keep listening and learning from each of you. Your voice will inform my voice and my votes, because that is what a representative should do. For too many years, Congress has been filled with politicians who defer to their own interests and party pressures, instead of representing the people who elected them. When I get elected, my top priority is representing **your** needs and interests. I plan to keep meeting our community where they are, and I could really use your help to make sure we can.[ **Can you donate to my campaign before Midnight tonight so we can finish this month strong?** ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138262840/643613948/524014055?refcode=20260831&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTgyNDQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjI1ODcwOGItNzZhNS1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=IvBSh1NwwUFElQP56uNY3lD_6byk3GgIux5EV9UI-AQ=)Every donation helps get us the resources we need to keep holding events, so I can keep deferring to the experts.

Vice is not virtue.
In ordinary times, where objective truth were not under constant attack from the Marxist left, when men knew what a "man" is and women knew what a "woman" is, when black is not white and up is not down, such a statement as "vice is not virtue" would not be a necessary op-ed prelude.
But these are not ordinary times. Marx and Hegel and Wittgenstein and Satan have all spit in a cup and created a vicious, nasty disease even more poisonous than the Wuhan flu.
Society is sick with it.
Truth itself has always been in question. Two thousand years ago Pontius Pilate asked our Lord "_Quid est veritas? What is truth_?" but that is not what is happening today. Nor is truth challenged as it has been by every person in the history of mankind. Ask parents discussing curfew time with their teenager about truth being challenged "Curfew? What's a curfew? Since when is there a curfew..." but that is not what is happening either.
Warning, parents: if your kid starts with that line of leftist, sanctimonious rationale, the feigned ignorance with a smirk, the condescending irritation that you dare assert objective truth, get a handle on them now for their own good, before it gets worse. Those who deny truth do bad things. And then they vote democrat.
Virtue must be recognized.

5-minute read · 4 stories
Lead Story · EnergyTRUMP TOUTS 65 BILLION BARRELS OF VENEZUELAN OIL AS PUMP PRICES SIT AT $4.08What's Happening
* President Trump announced Friday an agreement giving the United States majority control over more than **65 billion barrels** of Venezuela's proven reserves, spanning **17 oil fields**. On Truth Social he called it "THE BIGGEST OIL DEAL IN WORLD HISTORY."
* The structure is narrower than the headline number. According to a U.S. official who described the terms to the Associated Press, the United States receives a **55% effective interest** in oil produced by a new private company formed to manage the reserves — not immediate title to the barrels. The deal also lets the U.S. purchase Venezuelan crude at cost.
* Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the arrangement would bring nearly **$100 billion** in private investment into Venezuela. Energy Secretary Chris Wright is expected to travel to Venezuela as soon as this week.
* AAA puts the national average for regular gasoline at **$4.08 a gallon** , up from $3.20 a year ago.

The Situation
* Venezuela's total proven reserves are estimated near **300 billion barrels** , the largest in the world, so the 65 billion figure is roughly a fifth of the total. Trump's claim that the deal more than doubles American oil reserves is his own and was not independently sourced in the reporting.
* The crude will not reach the market quickly. Rystad Energy estimated in July that Venezuelan output could rise about **17% by 2028** , but only with far more drilling, well rework, infrastructure and rig availability — work measured in years and billions of dollars.
* Venezuela's oil is extremely heavy and hard to move, and ExxonMobil CEO Darren Woods has previously described the country as un-investable. Any sustained production increase depends on a steady diluent supply.
* Today's elevated pump prices trace largely to the disruption in the Strait of Hormuz stemming from the six-month conflict with Iran, not to Venezuelan supply.

The PerspectiveLocking up the hemisphere's largest reserves without taxpayer money, and pulling them out of Beijing's and Moscow's orbit, is the kind of strategic leverage Washington has talked about for two decades and rarely delivered. That part is a real win. Peter,
This is not something we like to send, but tonight we are forced to do it: our team is falling short of our end of month goal at the worst possible time, with a little more than 2 months until the midterm election.
Defend Our Courts has been at the epicenter of the fight for voting rights, democracy, and rule of law.
We've done this by targeting races most Democratic groups ignore: judicial state supreme court races. We support ethical judges and candidates for elected judicial positions who answer to the Constitution and the law. Not Donald Trump.
We engaged in hand to hand political combat with Trump's anointed ground general, Scott Presler, in Pennsylvania, the birthplace of American democracy--and we won.
We defeated MAGA, saved three Democratic state supreme court justices, and helped preserve abortion and voting rights for millions of Pennsylvanians.
But our mission is not confined to one state. It can't be. Trump's agenda is to "take over the voting" of every state in America. He is using the USPS to attack mail-in voting, sending the FBI to seize ballots in swing states like Georgia, and using DHS and ICE to intimidate, threaten, detain, and kill Americans who stand in his way.
That's why these deadlines and the goals behind them matter: we're up against a coordinated, well-funded opposition hellbent on beating us into submission. We are falling short (about $1,618 behind where we need to be right now), and putting out the call for a few heroes tonight to step up and power us through this difficult moment onward to the midterm election.

body:
Why Rocky Mountain Voice exists—and why every reader, share and
subscriber matters in the fight for Colorado’s future.

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

AUGUST 31, 2026

MONDAY NEWS DIGEST

Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,

Every once in a while, someone writes something about Rocky Mountain
Voice that makes us stop and remember exactly why we started this in
the first place.

This week, contributor C. J. Garbo did just that.
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

His argument begins with a challenge to Colorado conservatives: _STOP
COMPLAINING ABOUT THE MEDIA. BUILD ONE._

For years, so much of our political energy has been focused on the
next candidate, the next campaign and the next election. But as C. J.
points out, elections are really the end of a much longer process.

Long before someone fills out a ballot, they've already formed
opinions about whether they feel safe in their neighborhood, whether
they can afford their home, whether their children's schools are
serving them, whether government is spending their money
responsibly—and, perhaps most importantly, which institutions they
trust to tell them the truth.

_THAT'S WHY ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE EXISTS.
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

When we started RMV, we knew Coloradans desperately needed another
voice in a media landscape that too often tells only one side of the
story. But this has grown into something much bigger than simply
publishing articles.

In 2025 alone, RMV published more than 800 original articles from 98
independent writers, generated 12.5 million social media views and 1.6
million interactions, added more than 46,000 followers, and recorded
more than 166,000 downloads of the Mountain Minute. Today, our email
network reaches roughly 200,000 people. And those numbers have already
catapulted in 2026.

Those numbers aren't about bragging rights. They're about impact.
Because as we've said before, political pressure comes from numbers.

One person asking a question can be ignored. Ten thousand people
asking it become much harder to dismiss. Hundreds of thousands of
informed Coloradans paying attention can change the conversation
entirely.

But C. J. also makes an important point that we take seriously: the
answer to biased media cannot simply be biased media from the other
side.

We are proudly right-of-center and pro-Colorado. We will investigate
government overreach, defend constitutional rights, follow taxpayer
dollars and cover stories the legacy media ignores. But our
credibility depends on being willing to follow the facts wherever they
lead—even when they're inconvenient to our own side.

The facts have to come first. That's how trust is built. And that's
how we build something that lasts beyond the next election.

_SO TODAY, WE'RE ASKING YOU TO HELP US KEEP BUILDING._

Read our stories. Forward them to someone who might not already agree
with you. Send us tips. Challenge us when we get something wrong.
Share our reporting when we get something right. Invite your friends
and neighbors into this community. And if you're able, support the
work financially.
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

Read C. J.'s full commentary here: _Stop complaining about the media.
Build one — Colorado conservatives already are.
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

Colorado doesn't need another political echo chamber. It needs an
informed citizenry willing to ask questions, hold power accountable
and fight to keep this state free for the generations that come after
us.

That's what we're building. And we're so grateful you're building it
with us.

In truth & liberty,
Team RMV

TOP STORIES OF THE WEEK

WHAT THE SUPREME COURT DID, AND DID NOT DO, ON TRUMP’S MAIL-BALLOT
ORDER
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

The Supreme Court handed the Trump administration a win Monday on
mail-in voting, and the headlines said so. But for a Colorado voter,
nothing has changed yet. The state remains set to send November
ballots under existing rules, because a second court order the
justices did not touch still blocks the part of the president’s plan
most directly tied to how voters receive their ballots.

A SOCIALIST ENDORSEMENT FOR MAYOR: WHAT DENVER DSA’S BACKING OF
SHONTEL LEWIS MEANS.
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

Denver’s Democratic Socialists of America chapter has picked a
candidate in the 2027 race for mayor. In an August 25 release, the
chapter said it was “proud to announce their endorsement of
Councilwoman Shontel M. Lewis for Mayor of Denver in the 2027
election.”

DOUGCO’S CHARTER PROPOSAL PROTECTS SCHOOLS FROM COMPETITION, NOT
CHOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY KIM GILMARTIN, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

_Douglas County has long been known as a community that values school
choice, which is one reason a resolution recently advanced by the
Douglas County School District (DCSD) Board of Education deserves much
more attention than it has received._

STATE

WEISER’S BLUEPRINT: THE COSTS THE PLAN LEAVES OUT
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

Phil Weiser’s Colorado Blueprint is full of numbers. It reports the
almost $900 million his office recovered in opioid settlements. It
counts the more than $184 million in AmeriCorps funding he sued to
recover, and the nearly $32 million his office won from the
e-cigarette maker JUUL.

THREE FEDERAL CASES TEST WHETHER COLORADO TREATS GUN RIGHTS AS POLICY
OR AS A LIMIT ON GOVERNMENT
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY C. J. GARBO, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

_Colorado has spent more than a generation treating the Second
Amendment as a public-policy question. That is the first mistake. The
Bill of Rights does not identify subjects upon which government may
act whenever legislators believe their intentions are sufficiently
benevolent._

COLORADO VOTERS TO DECIDE WHETHER TO CAP STATE INCOME TAX AT 4.4%
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

COLORADO POLITICS
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

Election officials on Thursday confirmed that the proposal to cap the
state’s income tax at the current rate submitted signatures and
voters will consequently decide its fate this November.

[ AUGUST 31, 2026 MONDAY NEWS DIGEST Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family, Every once in a while, someone writes something about Rocky Mountain Voice that makes us stop and remember exactly why we started this in the first place. This week, contributor C. J. Garbo did just that. [ His argument begins with a challenge to Colorado conservatives: STOP COMPLAINING ABOUT THE MEDIA. BUILD ONE. For years, so much of our political energy has been focused on the next candidate, the next campaign and the next election. But as C. J. points out, elections are really the end of a much longer process. Long before someone fills out a ballot, they've already formed opinions about whether they feel safe in their neighborhood, whether they can afford their home, whether their children's schools are serving them, whether government is spending their money responsibly—and, perhaps most importantly, which institutions they trust to tell them the truth. THAT'S WHY ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE EXISTS. [ When we started RMV, we knew Coloradans desperately needed another voice in a media landscape that too often tells only one side of the story. But this has grown into something much bigger than simply publishing articles. In 2025 alone, RMV published more than 800 original articles from 98 independent writers, generated 12.5 million social media views and 1.6 million interactions, added more than 46,000 followers, and recorded more than 166,000 downloads of the Mountain Minute. Today, our email network reaches roughly 200,000 people. And those numbers have already catapulted in 2026. Those numbers aren't about bragging rights. They're about impact. Because as we've said before, political pressure comes from numbers. One person asking a question can be ignored. Ten thousand people asking it become much harder to dismiss. Hundreds of thousands of informed Coloradans paying attention can change the conversation entirely. But C. J. also makes an important point that we take seriously: the answer to biased media cannot simply be biased media from the other side. We are proudly right-of-center and pro-Colorado. We will investigate government overreach, defend constitutional rights, follow taxpayer dollars and cover stories the legacy media ignores. But our credibility depends on being willing to follow the facts wherever they lead—even when they're inconvenient to our own side. The facts have to come first. That's how trust is built. And that's how we build something that lasts beyond the next election. SO TODAY, WE'RE ASKING YOU TO HELP US KEEP BUILDING. Read our stories. Forward them to someone who might not already agree with you. Send us tips. Challenge us when we get something wrong. Share our reporting when we get something right. Invite your friends and neighbors into this community. And if you're able, support the work financially. [ Read C. J.'s full commentary here: Stop complaining about the media. It needs an informed citizenry willing to ask questions, hold power accountable and fight to keep this state free for the generations that come after us. That's what we're building. And we're so grateful you're building it with us. The state remains set to send November ballots under existing rules, because a second court order the justices did not touch still blocks the part of the president’s plan most directly tied to how voters receive their ballots. subject: You probably know what this is about, Peter
body:
I want you to have a stake in the movement we’re building.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1186&source=&t=1&akid=3166%2E124072%2EZ5bJqg) | | | |
---
Peter – you probably know what this is about.
With just a few hours to go until our critical end-of-month fundraising deadline, we’re about $35,000 short of what we need to reach our goal.
Now, I know that sounds like a lot – but I also know from experience that when this grassroots team comes together, there’s nothing we cannot accomplish.
Of course, I wouldn’t ask you to write a check for that much, or anything even close to it. I’m just asking you to be a part of this team and to have a stake in the movement we’re building here in North Carolina.
Your contribution – of $5, $10 or whatever fits in your budget – will get us closer to where we need to be. You’ll help us raise the critical resources we need to keep ads on the air and momentum on our side to win this battleground race.
[**_So please, will you chip in any amount you can now to help us close this gap before midnight tonight?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1186&amount=5&t=8&akid=3166%2E124072%2EZ5bJqg)

---
Thanks so much, Peter.
Roy Cooper

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1186&t=2&akid=3166%2E124072%2EZ5bJqg)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1186&source=&t=3&akid=3166%2E124072%2EZ5bJqg)

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. name: Congressman Vince Fong
subject: Zero trains. $200 billion. Still not done.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vince Fong for Congress
body:
In 2008, voters were promised a $33 billion bullet train connecting San Francisco to Los Angeles, up and running by 2020. | | |
---
| |
# Zero trains. $200 billion. Still not done.
---
| Dear Friend,

I recently sat down with Fox Business to talk about the biggest boondoggle in California history: high-speed rail.
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/UVkSlwCpkSC?e=affd398937&c2id=4fd8e839bd16eef39626cb246bcc01d8)
---
| In 2008, voters were promised a $33 billion bullet train connecting San Francisco to Los Angeles, up and running by 2020. It's 2026. There is not one mile of usable track. Not one train. And the price tag? It's ballooned to $200 billion, nearly a 400% increase over what voters approved. California has already burned through $15 billion with nothing to show for it. Here in the Central Valley, we've paid the real price: farmland torn up, neighborhoods split apart, all while our local roads and bridges crumble from neglect. This isn't infrastructure. It's a monument to government waste. We can see the monument when we drive on I-5 in Fresno. I've been fighting this every step of the way. I pushed for the accountability that led the Trump administration to finally pull the plug on federal funding for this train wreck. As I told Fox Business: "Californians were promised a completed rail 6 years ago. Today we've spent billions and billions, for a total of zero trains." Sacramento wants to keep pouring your tax dollars into this hole. I want to stop it — and redirect resources toward infrastructure that actually works for Central Valley families. Thank you for standing with me, Sincerely

Congressman Vince Fong

subject: 64 days, midnight deadline
body:
My Democrat opponent has a $4 million head start. |

Fellow Patriot - I will make this quick because we do not have much time before August is over.

_We're behind and running on fumes._

The Special and Runoff elections were expensive. We had to put every dollar we raised into winning.

clean_body: He earned dozens of commendations. | | | | | | Dear Fellow American,This officer was just convicted of manslaughter for trying to stop a fleeing criminal with non-lethal force. Sgt. Erik Duran dedicated 15 years of his life to the NYPD.He earned dozens of commendations. He helped take illegal guns off the streets. He put his life on the line to protect his community. Now he's fighting for his own freedom – All because of a split-second decision he made during a drug bust in the Bronx. | | | | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled.Duran had only moments to react.He didn't reach for his firearm.He didn't use deadly force. Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him. The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries.Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison.And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. Duran and helping fund his appeal.But legal battles like this are long, difficult, and incredibly expensive.And while Erik fights for his freedom, his wife and children are left carrying the burden alongside him. They’re not only facing the reality of their husband and father spending the next 9 years in prison.Their own lives have been threatened because of this case. That's why I’m asking for your help today. spent 15 years protecting others. Now he needs people like you standing behind him. you for standing with Sgt. Duran. Sincerely, | | | Jason Johnson, President Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. Newly surfaced videos of Arkansas Democrat United States Senate candidate Hallie Shoffner expose just how deep her Green New Deal roots run. In the footage, Shoffner mocks President Trump and his MAGA supporters, praises Joe Biden and Kamala Harris' Inflation Reduction Act for pumping billions of dollars into climate programs, and admits she once worked for a Seattle "environmental lobby group," a group she conveniently declined to name.

After extensive research, Loomer Unleashed has identified that group as Environment Washington, an organization campaigning to make America "fossil fuel free" and to get Americans out of their cars.
In a 2021 video, Shoffner mocked President Trump and his MAGA supporters by wearing a red and white parody hat reading:
> _" Make Climate Great Again"_
Shoffner then, in her own words, made clear that climate alarmism is what drives her:
> _" As a farmer, what really keeps me up at night is how dramatically our climate is changing. That's why it's essential and urgent for me to prepare for these challenges. And I'm excited and honored to participate in the webinar Commodity AG: The Changing Climate and Your Bottom Line."_

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color.
