name: Swing Left
subject: Why Ground Truth was on MSNOW three times today:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
MSNOW joined us at a canvass in Michigan and aired multiple reports on how Ground Truth is moving voters.
#
Hi there,
As Election Day gets closer and closer (just 9 weeks away tomorrow!), this community is working hard to have a meaningful impact in the swing districts and states Democrats need to win this November.
This past weekend, Swing Left held another Weekend of Action, when volunteers knocked on more doors than any other weekend so far this election cycle!
**MSNOW’s chief political reporter Chris Jansing joined us at a canvass in Michigan, and the channel today aired not one, but _three_ great reports on what volunteers across the country are building with Ground Truth, our innovative deep canvassing program. Here’s a clip from the show _Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle:_**
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-2025-sl-em20260831.w6kD53&refcode=em20260831-2637&t=1&akid=2637%2E1562180%2E99_K-v)
They got it exactly right: Ground Truth volunteers are finding voters that traditional Democratic field programs miss, including voters that could swing to vote for Democrats and help us beat Republicans in critical races—which is only possible with thousands of volunteers like you around the country knocking on doors and having conversations.
And through Ground Truth, volunteers are rebuilding trust with all voters—including Republicans, independents, and waning Democrats—by listening first to what they have to say. Instead of reading off the usual scripts, we have real, open-ended conversations with voters and give them the space to tell us about their concerns.
We then take notes on what we hear, and then aggregate all that important data, and make it available to campaigns and party committees so they can fine-tune their messaging and outreach strategies ahead of Election Day.
This weekend, we heard from a Republican who said she would put the president in jail, a grandmother on Social Security who said she had to go to a food bank, and a three-time Trump voter who says he was lied to.
None of these people would have had their door knocked on in a traditional Democratic field operation, but this weekend, they spoke to a volunteer who listened to them.
We’ll have more details on how this weekend’s canvasses went soon, so make sure to be on the lookout for that in the coming days. But overall, we’re proud of the progress we’ve made so far, and excited to see what we can accomplish together as we continue scaling up ahead of November.
[**Make sure to give the MSNOW segment a watch by clicking here. Then, consider making a donation of any amount to help fund more voter conversations in the swing districts and states that will decide this year’s elections.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-2025-sl-em20260831.w6kD53&refcode=em20260831-2637&t=2&akid=2637%2E1562180%2E99_K-v)
**[Donate Now](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-2025-sl-em20260831.w6kD53&refcode=em20260831-2637&t=3&akid=2637%2E1562180%2E99_K-v)**
As always, thank you for everything you do.
– The Swing Left Team
P.S. You can check out the other two Ground Truth features on MSNOW from today [**here**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2324?t=4&akid=2637%2E1562180%2E99_K-v) and [**here**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2325?t=5&akid=2637%2E1562180%2E99_K-v).

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20260831-1&t=6&refcode2=2637_1562180_99_K-v&akid=2637%2E1562180%2E99_K-v)

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: A personal note
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
I wanted to write you a longer note leading into the final hours of our first end-of-month deadline for the general election.
Peter, it has been 26 days since we won that primary together; only a few weeks since we launched this general election. November already feels close.
I want to level with you about what those weeks have looked like from where I sit. This email is a little long, so I hope you'll stay with me. 🙏
**The Republicans were waiting for us.** By the time we finished a tough primary, Mike Rogers' side had already spent more than $45 million on air to make him look good. He is a 30-year career politician and Donald Trump's handpicked candidate, with over a year of spending and statewide name recognition _already_ built.
And they didn't stop at the flattering Rogers ads. They had attack ads on us ready to go. Sometimes brutal. Sometimes offensive. Sometimes just silly.
The right-wing media and influencer world has been running waves of it. Attacks on my religion. Calling our most basic proposals (what if everyone had health care?) “communism.” Clipping every little thing I've ever said out of context.
I have the wrong name, I pray the wrong way, I have the wrong skin color. They have decided that's the whole argument this election will hinge on.
**Peter, they need to distract Michiganders to win. If this election is a side-by-side matchup of our ideas against theirs, it's a rout in our favor.**
We stand for money out of politics, money in your pocket, and Medicare for All. They stand for jacking up your drug costs, spending your tax money abroad on useless wars, and taking as much corporate cash as humanly possible along the way.
And Rogers has a paper trail on every bit of it:
* He’s the same guy who championed the trade deals that outsourced hundreds of thousands of Michigan manufacturing jobs.

* The same guy who raked in over a million dollars from Big Pharma and Wall Street banks, including over $400,000 in campaign contributions from big drug companies.

* The same guy who called himself the “champion” of the opioid industry while tens of thousands of Michiganders were dying of overdoses, and he backed legislation giving drug makers near “absolute immunity” from deaths and damages their drugs cause.

* Then he left Congress, increased his net worth by up to $14 million working for the corporations he used to regulate, and moved to Florida.

That's the record they'd rather this race _not_ be about, which is why they want it to be about my name instead.
I'm a doctor, not a politician. As a public servant, I spearheaded a program that will cancel up to $700 million in medical debt for 300,000 Michiganders and got free glasses onto the faces of thousands of kids who needed them.
**If voters see all of that laid bare, we win big. If the MAGA media machine derails this election because we don't have the resources to answer, we could lose.** That's just me being blunt about the stakes here.
It's also what I'm thinking about heading into tonight...
We're at our end-of-month fundraising deadline, the first of this general election, and one of the last before votes get counted. **_The only way this goes right is if we hit our goals week after week, because that's what fuels the operation getting our message out: TV, mail, events, and the doors._**
We won the most expensive Democratic Senate primary in the country's history without a single dollar from corporate PACs or AIPAC, while more than $70 million was spent against us by AIPAC and corporate interests.
That fight nearly beat us, and it emptied our bank account at the exact moment the real one started. Now, the GOP's Senate Leadership Fund has committed $51 million to elect Rogers, and their attack ads are already on the air.
I don't take a dime of corporate PAC money and I never will. So when I need help, I don't call a lobbyist. I write to you, Peter!
**Will you donate $5 or any amount before tonight's midnight deadline so we can answer the MAGA attack ads instead of letting them define this race? Here’s the link:**
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20260831-3-ak**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260831-3-ak.1GPjAb&amount=5&refcode=em20260831-3070&t=2&akid=3070%2E251025%2E7Oml__)
Michigan could be the final seat to decide control of the U.S. Senate. One seat, a few weeks, and a state where the last Senate race came down to 20,217 votes.
Grassroots money is our _only_ way to answer $51 million. **Every ad, every mailer, every door, every undecided voter who hears from us first happens because someone reading an email like this one decided to chip in.**
I know I ask a lot of you. I'm grateful for every bit of it, and if tonight isn't the right time, that's okay. Thank you for reading this far.
Your friend in the fight,
Abdul

* * *
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Emails like this help us stay connected with grassroots supporters like you, so thank you for taking the time to read this message. To contribute via check, please address it to Abdul for U.S. Senate, PO Box 126, St. Clair Shores, MI 48080.
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails?t=3&akid=3070%2E251025%2E7Oml__)

* [Unsubscribe](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=4&akid=3070%2E251025%2E7Oml__)

Email us: [info@abdulformichigan.com](info@abdulformichigan.com)

Will you donate $5 or any amount before tonight's midnight deadline so we can answer the MAGA attack ads instead of letting them define this race? Here’s the link: Michigan could be the final seat to decide control of the U.S. Senate. One seat, a few weeks, and a state where the last Senate race came down to 20,217 votes. Grassroots money is our only way to answer $51 million. Every ad, every mailer, every door, every undecided voter who hears from us first happens because someone reading an email like this one decided to chip in. I know I ask a lot of you. I'm grateful for every bit of it, and if tonight isn't the right time, that's okay. Thank you for reading this far. Your friend in the fight, Abdul

Roy Cooper

It's Sherrod Brown.

There's nobody fighting for Ohioans in the U.S. Senate right now, and I won't sit on the sidelines while working people get screwed over by large corporations and wealthy political donors.

If you work hard, you should be able to afford a decent life. But the reality is, life is too expensive. Costs are going up. Wages are staying stagnant. Working people are working harder than ever before, and they're not getting their share of the profit.
